name: Ancient Allies
summary: A hermit points you toward an outpost of ancients and dryads on Mount Hyjal’s lower slopes. Fraxinus and his companions may help with the climb ahead.

sections.title: The Mountain's Keepers
sections.body: The hermit has little more to offer as you prepare for the long climb up Mount Hyjal. He directs you west from his cave, then north toward the mountain’s foot. There, an outpost remains from the guardians who once roamed these slopes. Fraxinus, an ancient, and his friends may assist you.

faq.answer: Fraxinus is an ancient at an outpost on Mount Hyjal’s lower slopes.
The outpost lies west of the hermit’s cave, near the foot of Mount Hyjal.
Ancients and dryads are at the outpost, remnants of the guardians who once roamed Mount Hyjal’s slopes.
The hermit says Fraxinus and his companions may assist you on the long trek up Mount Hyjal.
